# Poly Haven assets used by this demo (CC0)

Loaded at render time from the shared folder `core/assets/polyhaven/` (see `src/room.js`); nothing is copied here.

- tea_set_01 — https://polyhaven.com/a/tea_set_01
- walnut_diff/nor/rough.jpg — american_walnut_veneer, https://polyhaven.com/a/american_walnut_veneer

Lighting is three.js `RoomEnvironment` (procedural). The HDRIs (lythwood_lounge, photo_studio_loft_hall) and desk_lamp_arm_01 in `core/assets/polyhaven/` are not used by this demo.
